d:
Türkiye or Turkey has much more to offer than just Istanbul and Cappadocia. I explored less popular places in Turkey or, let's say, offbeat Turkey for almost a month in late 2022. During this trip, I found most of these less popular places were in Afyonkarahisar & Nevsehir. I stayed in the village and experienced the real Turkish culture. This video provides a sneak peek of what you can expect in the upcoming videos.
